test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**of**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate preposition for the given blank is '**of**'.
 
• Here, it means** 'belonging to, connected with, or part of something/somebody'.** (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के स्‍वामित्‍ववाला, से संबंधित या उसका भाग; का)
 
 
• *Example: a friend **of** mine [one of my friends]*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *I studied at the J.J. School of Art in Mumbai, India’s premier institute __**of**__ (1) art and design. After two years I (2)______ New York City to further my studies. I soon (3)______ myself in a totally different culture which I embraced (4)______ willingly. Interestingly, it was in New York that I began (5)______ different cuisines. *

44:T75b,

The correct answer is **'moved to'.**</p&g
